# Rodentia
Rodentia are a species of bipedal beings resembling rodents. Resourceful, evasive, sneaky, but fragile.
## Unique Abilities
### Rummaging
- Rodentia can rummage in disposal chutes, which can sometimes [color=#1e90ff]dig up food.[/color] Yum!
### Rodent Storage
- Rodentia can store small items in their cheeks. Having items in their mouth makes their speech unintelligible, and they will drop all items in their mouth if attacked, stunned, or shoved.
### Sneaking
- Due to their small stature and rodent instincts, Rodentia can [color=#1e90ff]sneak underneath tables.[/color] However, they are unable to sneak under doors.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get [color=#FFA500]poisoned[/color] by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- They can use their claws to do some [color=#ec3a3a]Slashing[/color] and [color=#ec3a3a]Blunt[/color] damage. - They can fit in duffelbags.
## Drawbacks
- Takes [color=#FFA500]15% more Blunt, Slash, and Piercing damage.[/color] - Always triggers mousetraps, regardless of whether or not they are wearing shoes. - Gets [color=#FFA500]hungry 33% faster.[/color]
## Rodentia Naming Conventions
Rodentia use a naming scheme which features a descriptor as their first name and a last name typically inspired by onomatopoeia, a food, or a name derived from another species. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Big Muffin - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Fast-moving Comet - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Quiet Squeaks - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Sharp Jesse - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Fucking Jim - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Stilted Jeronimo - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Stuart Little
## Lore
Rodentia, rather than simply being a singular species, is the general term for a multitude of rodent resembling species throughout the galaxy. Interestingly, most of the Rodentia collective originated from the same world bringing into question whether or not Rodentia are an example of natural evolution or genetic creation. Rodentia culture is highly diverse, but many have the common through line of not caring whether their origins are evolution or being made and instead focus on the importance of being here.
